chunks: So remember the destroyer of joys, the spoiler of pleasures, and the severer of hopes, at the time of deliberating for evil deeds, and seek Allah's assistance in fulfilling His obligatory right, and for (thanking Him) for His countless bounties and favors.
ai.seo_question: How does one remember death to avoid evil deeds according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this passage from the Sermons of Imam Ali, death is personified as the ultimate reality that dismantles worldly comforts and aspirations, serving as a spiritual anchor during moments of moral deliberation. This reflection encourages believers to actively seek divine assistance in fulfilling their obligations and cultivating gratitude for the innumerable, often uncountable, blessings of Allah.

en.sayed-ali-raza: At the time of committing evil deeds remember the destroyer of joys, the spoiler of pleasures, and the killer of desires (namely death). Seek assistance of Allāh for fulfilment of His obligatory rights, and for (thanking Him) for His countless bounties and obligations.
